questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) । नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प चुनिए : अभिकथन (A) : पूर्ण रोज़गार स्थिति से तात्पर्य अनैच्छिक बेरोज़गारी की अनुपस्थिति से है । कारण (R) : पूर्ण रोज़गार की स्थिति में, सभी इच्छुक व सक्षम व्यक्तियों को प्रचलित मज़दूरी दर पर रोज़गार प्राप्त होता है ।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements - Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct alternative given below : Assertion (A): Full employment situation refers to absence of involuntary unemployment. Reason (R): Under full employment situation, all the willing and able bodied people get employment at the prevailing wage rate.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है ।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है ।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Option A is correct because full employment is defined as the situation where all individuals who are willing and able to work at the prevailing wage rate are employed. Consequently, involuntary unemployment does not exist in this state, making the reason a correct explanation of the assertion.

questions.text: "दिनांक 9 जून 2023 के, नेशनल स्टॉक एक्सचेंज (NSE) के आँकड़ों के अनुसार, एक माह की अवधि यानि, 9 मई 2023 - 9 जून 2023, में विदेशी संस्थागत निवेशकों (FII) द्वारा ₹ 309 करोड़ की शुद्ध बिक्री की गई थी ।" उपर्युक्त लेन-देन भारत के भुगतान संतुलन के _______ खाते के _______ पक्ष में दर्ज किया जाएगा ।
questions.text_english: "As per the National Stock Exchange (NSE) data, dated 9th June, 2023, there was a net selling off worth ₹309 crore by Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) over the period of one month i.e., 9th May, 2023- 9th June, 2023." The above mentioned transactions will be recorded on _______ side of _______ account of Balance of Payments of India.
questions.instruction_line: (रिक्त स्थानों को भरने के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct alternative to fill in the blanks)
questions.solution: Option D is correct. FII transactions relate to assets and liabilities in the financial markets, which fall under the Capital Account. Selling off assets results in an outflow of funds, which is recorded on the Debit side.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से मुद्रा आपूर्ति (M1) की असत्य विशेषता / विशेषताओं की पहचान कीजिए : (i) इसे समय के एक बिंदु पर मापा जाता है । (ii) इसमें सरकार के पास रखे गए धन-भंडार को सम्मिलित नहीं किया जाता है। (iii) यह सदैव राष्ट्र के केन्द्रीय बैंक के पास रखी मुद्रा होती है ।
questions.text_english: Identify the incorrect feature(s) of money supply (M1) from the following: (i) It is measured at a point of time. (ii) It does not include stock of money held by the government. (iii) It is always the currency in the hands of the Central Bank of a nation.
questions.solution: Option D is correct. M1 includes currency held by the public and demand deposits with commercial banks. It is not currency held by the Central Bank, making statement (iii) incorrect.

questions.text: कीन्स के अनुसार घरेलू क्षेत्र द्वारा किया गया कुल उपभोग व्यय _______ व _______ का संयोजन है ।
questions.text_english: Total consumption expenditure by households under Keynesian Economics is a combination of _______ and _______.
questions.instruction_line: (रिक्त स्थानों को भरने के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct alternative to fill in the blanks)
questions.solution: Option D is correct. According to the Keynesian consumption function C = C_bar + bY, total consumption consists of autonomous consumption (C_bar, which occurs even at zero income) and induced consumption (bY, which varies with income levels).

questions.text_english: Find the missing figures and choose the correct alternative : Round | Deposits | Loans (80%) | Reserve Ratio (20%) | I | 5000 | 4000 | ..(i).. | II | 4000 | ..(ii).. | 800 | Total | ..(iii).. | ..(iv).. | 5000
questions.solution: Option C is correct. (i) 20% of 5000 = 1000. (ii) 80% of 4000 = 3200. Total deposit multiplier = 1/LRR = 1/0.2 = 5. Total deposits = 5000 * 5 = 25000. Total loans = 25000 - 5000 = 20000.

questions.text: भुगतान संतुलन (BOP) में अधिशेष का तात्पर्य _______ की अधिकता से है ।

questions.instruction_line: (रिक्त स्थान को भरने के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct alternative to fill in the blank)

options.B: स्वायत्त प्राप्तियों पर चालू खाता भुगतान
options.C: पूँजी खाता भुगतान पर पूँजी खाता प्राप्तियों

options_english.B: Current Account payments over Autonomous receipts
options_english.C: Capital Account receipts over Capital Account payments

questions.solution: Option D is correct. A surplus in the Balance of Payments occurs when autonomous receipts exceed autonomous payments, leading to a positive net balance before considering accommodating transactions.

questions.text: किसी काल्पनिक अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए मान लीजिए कि : C=100+0.75Y (जहाँ C= उपभोग व Y= आय), I0=400 (I0= स्वायत्त निवेश) निवेश गुणक (K) का मान _______ होगा ।
questions.text_english: Suppose for a hypothetical economy: C=100+0.75Y (where C= Consumption and Y= Income), I0=400 (I0= Autonomous Investment) Value of Investment Multiplier (K) would be _______.
questions.instruction_line: (रिक्त स्थान को भरने के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct alternative to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: Option B is correct. Given MPC = 0.75, the multiplier formula is K = 1 / (1 - MPC). K = 1 / (1 - 0.75) = 1 / 0.25 = 4.

questions.text: मान लीजिए कि, एक काल्पनिक अर्थव्यवस्था का व्यापार संतुलन ₹ 500 करोड़ का अनुकूल संतुलन दर्शाता है । माल निर्यात का मूल्य ₹ 1200 करोड़ व हस्तांतरण भुगतान ₹ 400 करोड़ है । वाणिज्य (Merchandise) आयात का मूल्य _______ करोड़ होगा ।
questions.text_english: Suppose, the Balance of Trade of an imaginary economy shows a favourable balance of 500 crore. The values of merchandise exports are 1200 crore and transfer payments are 400 crore. The value of merchandise imports would be _______ crore.
questions.instruction_line: (रिक्त स्थान को भरने के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct alternative to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: Option C is correct. Balance of Trade = Export of goods - Import of goods. 500 = 1200 - Import. Import = 1200 - 500 = 700 crore. Transfer payments are not included in the Balance of Trade.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए : कथन 1 : यदि किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में, आय के स्तर में वृद्धि (ΔY) होती है, तो यह उपभोग के स्तर (ΔC) में सदैव आनुपातिक रूप से वृद्धि कर देगी । कथन 2 : सीमांत उपभोग प्रवृत्ति (MPC) व सीमांत बचत प्रवृत्ति (MPS) सदैव एक-दूसरे के बराबर होती हैं । दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Read the following statements carefully: Statement 1: If in an economy the level of income increases (ΔY), it will always proportionately increase the level of consumption (ΔC). Statement 2: Marginal Propensity to Consume (MPC) and Marginal Propensity to Save (MPS) are always equal to each other. In the light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है ।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Option D is correct. Statement 1 is false because consumption changes at a rate determined by MPC, not always proportionately (i.e., not equal to 1). Statement 2 is false because MPC + MPS = 1, they are not equal to each other unless both are 0.5.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से सही समीकरण की पहचान कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Identify the correct equation from the following:

options.C: GNPMP = GDPMP + विदेशों से प्राप्त शुद्ध साधन आय

options_english.C: GNPMP = GDPMP + Net Factor Income from Abroad

questions.solution: Option C is correct. GNPMP is calculated by adding Net Factor Income from Abroad (NFIA) to GDPMP. Option A is incorrect (should be NNPFC + Dep = GNPFC), Option B is incorrect (NDPFC = NDPMP - NIT), and Option D is incorrect (NNPFC = NDPFC + NFIA).

questions.text: (क) एक काल्पनिक अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए नीचे दिए गए आँकड़ों के आधार पर, साधन लागत पर शुद्ध घरेलू उत्पाद (NDPFC) के मूल्य का अनुमान लगाइए : (i) सकल घरेलू स्थायी पूँजी निर्माण: 300, (ii) निर्यात: 70, (iii) अंतिम सरकारी उपभोग व्यय: 400, (iv) स्थायी पूँजी का उपभोग: 50, (v) अंतिम घरेलू उपभोग व्यय: 590, (vi) मालसूची (Inventory) निवेश (शुद्ध): -60, (vii) आयात: 80, (viii) शुद्ध अप्रत्यक्ष कर: 50, (ix) विदेशों से प्राप्त शुद्ध कारक आय: 40
questions.text_english: (a) On the basis of the data given below for an imaginary economy, estimate the value of Net Domestic Product at Factor Cost (NDPFC): (i) Gross Domestic Fixed Capital Formation: 300, (ii) Exports: 70, (iii) Government Final Consumption Expenditure: 400, (iv) Consumption of Fixed Capital: 50, (v) Household Final Consumption Expenditure: 590, (vi) Inventory Investment (Net): -60, (vii) Imports: 80, (viii) Net Indirect Taxes: 50, (ix) Net Factor Income from Abroad: 40

sub_questions.text: साधन लागत पर शुद्ध घरेलू उत्पाद (NDPFC) का परिकलन कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Calculate Net Domestic Product at Factor Cost (NDPFC).

key_points: GDPMP = Household Final Consumption Expenditure + Government Final Consumption Expenditure + Gross Domestic Fixed Capital Formation + Inventory Investment + (Exports - Imports)
NDPFC = GDPMP - Consumption of Fixed Capital - Net Indirect Taxes

sub_questions.solution: Using the Expenditure Method, GDPMP = Private Final Consumption Expenditure + Government Final Consumption Expenditure + Gross Domestic Capital Formation (Fixed Capital Formation + Inventory Investment) + Net Exports. GDPMP = 590 + 400 + (300 - 60) + (70 - 80) = 1260. NDPFC = GDPMP - Consumption of Fixed Capital - Net Indirect Taxes = 1260 - 50 - 50 = 1160 crore.

sub_questions.text: अथवा: बाह्यताओं की अवधारणा का वर्णन कीजिए व प्रचालन अधिशेष को परिभाषित कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: OR: Elaborate the concept of Externalities with the help of suitable example. Define Operating Surplus.

key_points: Externalities are the benefits or harms caused by one entity to another without any payment.
Positive externalities example: Public parks, education.
Negative externalities example: Pollution.
Operating Surplus is income from property and entrepreneurship (rent + interest + profit).

sub_questions.solution: Externalities refer to the good or bad impacts an economic unit has on others without receiving any price or compensation for it. For example, a park established by a person provides a positive externality to the neighborhood. Operating Surplus is the sum of income from property and entrepreneurship, comprising rent, interest, and profits generated in the production process.

questions.text: स्थिर विनिमय दर प्रणाली तथा नम्य विनिमय दर प्रणाली के मध्य अंतर स्पष्ट कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Distinguish between fixed exchange rate system and flexible exchange rate system.

key_points: Fixed system: Exchange rate determined by the government/monetary authority.
Flexible system: Exchange rate determined by market forces of demand and supply.
Fixed system: Stable and predictable, but requires large foreign reserves.
Flexible system: Fluctuating, self-adjusting based on market conditions.

questions.solution: In a fixed exchange rate system, the value of the currency is officially set by the government or central bank, ensuring stability but requiring substantial foreign exchange reserves. Conversely, in a flexible exchange rate system, the exchange rate is determined entirely by the market forces of demand and supply for a currency. While the former offers predictability, the latter provides automatic adjustment to balance of payments imbalances.

questions.text: दिनांक 8 जून 2023 के 'द ईकोनोमिक टाइम्स' से उद्धृत निम्नलिखित गद्य का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए : "भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक (RBI) की दर निर्धारण समिति ने स्पष्ट रूप से बैंचमार्क ऋण दर को 6.5% पर अपरिवर्तित रखने का निर्णय लिया है । समिति ने समायोजन मौद्रिक नीति (Accommodating Monetary Policy) को वापस लेने पर ध्यान केन्द्रित करने के लिए मतदान किया है ।" दिए गए गद्य व सामान्य समझ के आधार पर निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए : (क) उपर्युक्त गद्य में दर्शाए गए आर्थिक मुद्दे को पहचानिए व चर्चा कीजिए । (ख) यदि दर निर्धारण समिति ने उक्त दर में कमी की होती, तो मुद्रा आपूर्ति के संभावित परिणामों की चर्चा कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Read the following text carefully from 'The Economic Times' dated 8th June, 2023: "The Reserve Bank of India's (RBI's) rate setting panel unanimously decided to keep the benchmark lending rate unchanged at 6.5%. The committee voted to remain focused on the withdrawal of accommodating monetary policy." On the basis of given text and common understanding, answer the following questions : (a) Identify and discuss the economic issue indicated in the above text. (b) Discuss the likely consequence on money supply if the rate setting panel would have decreased the said rate.

key_points: Issue is Monetary Policy management by RBI.
Focus is on maintaining price stability and controlling inflation while keeping interest rates steady.

sub_questions.solution: The economic issue presented is the management of monetary policy by the central bank. By keeping the benchmark rate (repo rate) unchanged at 6.5%, the RBI aims to maintain price stability and control inflation while facilitating economic growth. The focus on withdrawing the accommodating policy suggests a move toward tightening liquidity.

sub_questions.text: दर में कमी का मुद्रा आपूर्ति पर प्रभाव
sub_questions.text_english: Impact of rate reduction on money supply

key_points: Lower repo rate makes borrowing cheaper for commercial banks.
Banks lower interest rates for public, increasing credit demand.
Higher credit flow increases money supply in the economy.

sub_questions.solution: If the rate setting panel had decreased the benchmark interest rate, borrowing for commercial banks would have become cheaper. This would have incentivized banks to reduce their lending rates to the public, leading to an increase in the demand for loans and credit. Consequently, this would have resulted in an expansion of the money supply in the economy.

questions.solution: See sub-questions for detailed answers.

questions.text: (क) निम्नलिखित तालिका को पूरा कीजिए । आय के ₹200 करोड़ के स्तर पर उपभोग फलन का निर्माण कीजिए । (तालिका दी गई है) अथवा (ख) “किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में, प्रत्याशित समग्र आपूर्ति, प्रत्याशित समग्र माँग से कम है।” उत्पादन, आय व रोज़गार के स्तर पर इसके प्रभाव की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: (a) Complete the following table. Construct/Express the Consumption function at 200 crore level of income. (Table provided) OR (b) "In an economy, ex-ante Aggregate Supply is less than ex-ante Aggregate Demand." Explain its impact on the level of output, income and employment.

sub_questions.text: तालिका पूरी करें और उपभोग फलन लिखें।
sub_questions.text_english: Complete table and write consumption function.

key_points: At Y=0, S=-30, C=30. APC=C/Y (not defined for Y=0).
At Y=100, S=-10 (calculated from MPS=0.2), C=110, APC=1.1, MPS=0.2.
Consumption function: C = 30 + 0.7Y

sub_questions.solution: At zero income, autonomous consumption is 30. MPC = 1 - MPS = 1 - 0.2 = 0.8. Thus, the consumption function is C = 30 + 0.8Y. At Y=200, C = 30 + 0.8(200) = 190. Following the trend, values are calculated accordingly to maintain the given APC/MPS constraints.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों को वैध तर्कों द्वारा प्रमाणित कीजिए : (क) किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में, लेन-देन संबंधी उद्देश्यों के लिए, मुद्रा 'विनिमय के माध्यम' के रूप में कार्य करती है । (ख) किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में केन्द्रीय बैंक, बैंकों के बैंक के रूप में कार्य करता है ।
questions.text_english: Justify the following statements with valid arguments: (a) Money serves as the 'medium of exchange' for transactional purposes in an economy. (b) The Central Bank acts as Banker's Bank in an economy.

key_points: Money solves the double coincidence of wants problem of barter.
Money acts as a universally accepted medium to exchange goods/services.
Central bank maintains cash reserves of commercial banks.
Central bank provides loans to commercial banks (lender of last resort).

questions.solution: Money acts as a medium of exchange because it overcomes the lack of double coincidence of wants inherent in a barter system, allowing for seamless transactions. As a banker's bank, the Central Bank maintains the cash reserves of commercial banks, acts as a lender of last resort by providing liquidity when needed, and facilitates inter-bank settlements, ensuring the stability of the banking system.
questions.topic: Functions of Money and Central Bank

questions.text: (क) (i) नीचे दिए गए चार्ट का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए और निम्नलिखित पर सरकारी व्यय में बदलते रुझानों का विश्लेषण कीजिए : (I) कृषि और संबद्ध गतिविधियाँ, (II) यातायात (ii) 'राजस्व घाटे' व 'प्राथमिक घाटे' के बीच अंतर स्पष्ट कीजिए । अथवा (ख) निम्नलिखित को राजस्व प्राप्तियों अथवा पूँजीगत प्राप्तियों में वर्गीकृत कीजिए : (i) ऋण पर प्राप्त ब्याज, (ii) किसी सरकारी कम्पनी की बिक्री से विनिवेश प्राप्तियाँ, (iii) भारत में बालिका शिक्षा को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका (USA) सरकार द्वारा दी गई वित्तीय सहायता ।
questions.text_english: (a) (i) Study the following chart carefully and analyse the changing trends in the government expenditure on: (I) Agriculture and Allied Activities, (II) Transport (ii) Distinguish between 'Revenue deficit' and 'Primary deficit'. OR (b) Classify the following as Revenue receipts or Capital receipts: (i) Interest received on loan, (ii) Disinvestment receipts from the sale of a government company, (iii) Financial assistance by the Government of USA for promoting girl education in India.

key_points: Expenditure on Agriculture and Allied Activities shows an increase from 1.43 to 1.44 over the periods.

key_points: Revenue deficit = Total Revenue Expenditure - Total Revenue Receipts.
Primary deficit = Fiscal deficit - Interest payments.

sub_questions.solution: Revenue deficit is the excess of total revenue expenditure over total revenue receipts, indicating the government's inability to cover its recurring expenses. Primary deficit is calculated by subtracting interest payments from the fiscal deficit, reflecting the government's borrowing requirement excluding the cost of past debt.

questions.text_english: (a) Discuss briefly the concept of circular flow of income in a two-sector model. (b) "Real Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is a better indicator of economic growth of a nation as compared to the Nominal Gross Domestic Product (GDP)." Do you agree with the given statement? Justify your answer with a valid hypothetical numerical example.

key_points: Two sectors: Households and Firms.
Households provide factors of production to firms.
Firms provide goods/services to households.
Income flows as payments for factors, spending flows back as payments for goods.

sub_questions.solution: In a two-sector model consisting of households and firms, households provide factors of production (land, labor, capital, entrepreneurship) to firms, and in return receive factor payments (rent, wages, interest, profit). Firms then produce goods and services, which households purchase using their income. This creates a continuous, circular flow of income and expenditure within the economy.

key_points: Agree, Real GDP reflects change in volume of production only.
Nominal GDP reflects change in both volume and price.
Example: If production remains 10 units but price rises from 10 to 20, Nominal GDP doubles while Real GDP stays constant.

sub_questions.solution: Yes, I agree that Real GDP is a better indicator of economic growth. Nominal GDP can rise merely due to inflation even if physical production remains stagnant. Real GDP uses base year prices, isolating volume changes. For example, if an economy produces 100 units at 10 rupees in year 1 (GDP=1000) and still produces 100 units at 20 rupees in year 2, Nominal GDP is 2000, but Real GDP remains 1000, showing no actual growth.

questions.text: (क) वैध तर्कों द्वारा उल्लेख व व्याख्या कीजिए कि निम्नलिखित कथन सत्य हैं या असत्य : (i) हाल में, भारत सरकार ने वित्तीय संसाधनों के कुशलतम आबंटन के लिए जन-धन योजना जैसे कई महत्त्वपूर्ण कदम उठाए हैं । (ii) श्रमिक – जनसंख्या अनुपात किसी राष्ट्र में रोज़गार की स्थिति का विश्लेषण करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला एक संकेतक है । अथवा (ख) (i) भारत में महिला शिक्षा को प्रोत्साहित करने की आवश्यकता की व्याख्या कीजिए । (ii) गैर-कृषि प्रसंस्करण उद्योगों में विविधीकरण गतिविधियों के किन्हीं दो उदाहरणों का उल्लेख कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: (a) State and elaborate whether the following statements are true or false, with valid arguments: (i) In the recent past, the Government of India has taken crucial steps, like Jan-Dhan Yojana, for efficient allocation of financial resources. (ii) Worker - population ratio is an indicator, used for analyzing the employment situation in a nation. OR (b) (i) Elaborate the need to promote women's education in India. (ii) Mention any two examples of diversification activities in the non-agro processing industries.

key_points: True: Enhances financial inclusion and direct benefit transfers.

sub_questions.solution: True. The Jan-Dhan Yojana has significantly enhanced financial inclusion, ensuring that government subsidies and financial services reach the intended beneficiaries directly, thereby improving the efficiency of resource allocation.

key_points: True: Ratio shows the proportion of population actively engaged in work.

sub_questions.solution: True. The worker-population ratio is a vital indicator as it measures the proportion of a country's population that is actually employed, providing insight into the utilization of labor resources and the state of the labor market.

questions.solution: Explanations for statements provided in sub-questions.

questions.text: (क) भारत के ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में वित्तपोषण की सूक्ष्म ऋण (अतिलघु-साख) प्रणाली के कोई दो लाभ बताइए । (ख) “वर्तमान स्थिति में, भारत जैसे राष्ट्र में खाद्य सुरक्षा प्राप्त करने में सूचना प्रौद्योगिकी महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाती है ।” दिए गए कथन का औचित्य सिद्ध कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: (a) State any two advantages of micro-credit system of financing in rural areas of India. (b) "In the current situation, Information Technology plays a vital role in achieving food security in a nation like India." Justify the given statement.

key_points: Provides accessible credit to the poor who lack collateral.
Promotes self-employment and small income-generating activities.

sub_questions.solution: Micro-credit provides essential financial support to small borrowers in rural areas who often lack formal collateral, allowing them to engage in productive self-employment. It empowers marginalized groups, especially women, and promotes grassroots economic stability.

key_points: Provides accurate information on market prices and demand.
Helps in inventory management and supply chain efficiency.
Connects farmers directly to consumers, reducing wastage.

sub_questions.solution: Information Technology improves food security by providing farmers with real-time data on weather, crop advisory, and market prices, which enhances production efficiency. Furthermore, it helps manage the supply chain and Public Distribution System (PDS) more effectively, reducing losses and ensuring timely delivery of food to those who need it.

questions.solution: Benefits and justifications provided in sub-questions.

questions.text: (क) (i) “भारत सरकार द्वारा उठाए गए उदारीकरण उपायों के अंतर्गत, वित्तीय क्षेत्र में किए गए सुधार अत्यंत महत्वपूर्ण थे ।” दिए गए कथन का वैध तर्कों द्वारा खंडन अथवा समर्थन कीजिए । (ii) स्पष्ट कीजिए कि किस प्रकार हरित क्रांति ने सरकार को खाद्य पदार्थों की अल्पता के समय उपयोग करने के लिए भंडार बनाने के लिए पर्याप्त खाद्यान्न क्रय करने में सक्षम बनाया था । अथवा (ख) (i) “हर सिक्के के दो पहलू होते हैं - कृषि उपदान पर बहस भी ऐसा ही एक उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण है ।” कृषि उपदान जारी रखने के पक्ष व विपक्ष में दो-दो तर्कों सहित दिए गए कथन की पुष्टि कीजिए । (ii) भारतीय आर्थिक योजना के उद्देश्य के रूप में “समता के साथ संवृद्धि” के महत्व का उल्लेख कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: (a) (i) "Under the liberalisation measures taken by the Government of India, financial sector reforms were extremely crucial." Reject or support the given statement with valid arguments. (ii) Clarify, how the Green Revolution enabled the government to procure sufficient food grains to build stocks to be used during the times of food shortages. OR (b) (i) "Every coin has two sides - debate over farm subsidies is one such classic example of the same." Justify the given statement with two arguments each in favour of and against the continuation of the farm subsidies. (ii) State the importance of "Growth with equity" as the objective of Indian economic planning.

key_points: Support: Reforms reduced government control (RBI to regulator).
Allowed private and foreign banks entry.
Increased competition and efficiency.

sub_questions.solution: I support this statement. Financial sector reforms were crucial because they shifted the RBI's role from a regulator to a facilitator, allowing more competition from private and foreign banks. This increased efficiency in the banking sector and better managed capital allocation for economic growth.

key_points: Substantial increase in food grain production.
Marketable surplus allowed government procurement for buffer stocks.

sub_questions.solution: The Green Revolution led to a massive increase in the productivity and production of food grains, especially wheat and rice. This created a significant 'marketable surplus', allowing the government to procure sufficient quantities to build and maintain buffer stocks for food security during periods of scarcity.

questions.text:
भारत में वायु तथा जल प्रदूषण की दो प्रमुख पर्यावरण चिंताओं से निपटने के लिए सरकार ने 1974 में केंद्रीय प्रदूषण नियंत्रण बोर्ड (CPCB) की स्थापना की । इसके बाद, राज्य स्तर पर सभी पर्यावरणीय चिंताओं से निपटने के लिए राज्यों ने अपने-अपने बोर्ड बनाये । ये बोर्ड (CPCB) जल, वायु और भूमि प्रदूषण से संबंधित सूचनाओं का संकलन और वितरण करते हैं । वे कचरे/व्यापार निकास और उत्सर्जन के मानक निर्धारित करते हैं । ये बोर्ड सरकारों को जल प्रदूषण के रोकथाम, नियंत्रण और कमी के लिए जल-धाराओं द्वारा नदियों और कुओं की स्वच्छता के संवर्धन के लिए तकनीकी सहायता प्रदान करते हैं। इनका कार्य वायु की गुणवत्ता में सुधार भी है। ये देश में वायु प्रदूषण के नियंत्रण द्वारा भी सरकारों को तकनीकी सहायता प्रदान करते हैं ।

ये बोर्ड जल व वायु प्रदूषण से संबंधित समस्याओं की जाँच व अनुसंधान भी करते हैं और ऐसी जाँच व अनुसंधान को प्रायोजित करते हैं। इसके लिए वे जन संचार के माध्यम से जन जागरूकता कार्यक्रम संगठित करते हैं। PCB कचरे व वाणिज्य अपशिष्टों के निपटान और उपचार से संबंधित नियमावली, संहिता और मार्गदर्शक सूचिका तैयार करते हैं । उद्योगों के विनियमन द्वारा वे वायु गुणवत्ता का मूल्यांकन करते हैं । वास्तव में अपने जिला स्तरीय अधिकारियों के माध्यम से राज्य बोर्ड अपने क्षेत्राधिकार में आने वाले प्रत्येक उद्योग का समय-समय पर निरीक्षण, निकास और गैसीय उत्सर्जन हेतु उपलब्ध उपायों की पर्याप्तता का विश्लेषण करने के लिए करता है। यह उद्योग स्थान निर्धारण व नगर नियोजन के लिए आवश्यक पृष्ठभूमि तथा वायु गुणवत्ता आँकड़े भी प्रदान करता है ।

प्रदूषण नियंत्रण बोर्ड जल प्रदूषण से संबंधित तकनीकी और सांख्यिकी आँकड़ों का संकलन, संपादन और वितरण करते हैं। ये 125 नदियों (इसमें उपनदियाँ भी शामिल हैं), कुएँ, झील, खाड़ी, तालाब, टैंक, नाले और नहरों में जल की गुणवत्ता की देखरेख करते हैं।
questions.text_english:
In order to address two major environmental concerns in India, viz. water and air pollution, the government set up the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) in 1974. This was followed by states establishing their own state level boards to address all the environmental concerns. They investigate, collect and disseminate information relating to water, air and land pollution, lay down standards for sewage/trade effluent and emissions. These boards provide technical assistance to governments in promoting cleanliness of streams and wells by prevention, control and abatement of water pollution, and improve the quality of air and to prevent, control or abate air pollution in the country.

These boards also carry out and sponsor investigation and research relating to problems of water and air pollution and for their prevention, control or abatement. They organize, through mass media, a comprehensive mass awareness programme for the same. The PCBS prepare manuals, codes and guidelines relating to treatment and disposal of sewage and trade effluents.

They assess the air quality through regulation of industries. In fact, state boards, through their district level officials, periodically inspect every industry under their jurisdiction to assess the adequacy of treatment measures provided to treat the effluent and gaseous emissions. It also provides background air quality data needed for industrial siting and town planning.

The pollution control boards collect, collate and disseminate technical and statistical data relating to water pollution. They monitor the quality of water in 125 rivers (including the tributaries), wells, lakes, creeks, ponds, tanks, drains and canals.

key_points: Addressing major environmental concerns: Water pollution.
Addressing major environmental concerns: Air pollution.

sub_questions.solution: The two major environmental concerns that led to the establishment of the CPCB were water pollution and air pollution.

key_points: Determining standards for sewage/trade effluents and emissions.
Providing technical assistance to governments for pollution prevention/control.

sub_questions.solution: Two functions of the CPCB include establishing standards for sewage, trade effluents, and emissions, and providing technical assistance to governments for the prevention and control of water and air pollution.

key_points: Usage of non-conventional energy sources.
Promotion of organic farming.
Waste management and recycling.

sub_questions.solution: To ensure sustainable development, India has adopted several strategies. First, the promotion of non-conventional energy sources like solar and wind energy reduces dependence on fossil fuels, curbing emissions. Second, the promotion of organic farming minimizes the use of chemical fertilizers and pesticides, preserving soil health and reducing water pollution, which is essential for long-term ecological balance.
